segments.name: Confectionery products
segments.description: Manufactures and sells confectionery products to wholesale distributors, retailers, e-commerce merchants, the U.S. military and fund-raising organizations in the United States, Canada and Mexico.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it currently has one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The Company is paid by wholesale distributors, grocery and retail customers, e-commerce merchants, the U.S. military and fund-raising organizations for confectionery products sold through food and grocery brokers or directly.
revenueModel.evidence: They are sold through food and grocery brokers or directly by the Company to customers throughout the United States, Canada and Mexico.
